facts.business: NITCO Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of tiles and related products, and also undertakes real estate development activities including plotted development and property sales.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (i) Impairment and reclassification of Alibaug factory PPE to Assets Held for Sale; (ii) Non-provision for impairment of capital advance to Saumya Buildcon Pvt Ltd; (iii) ESOP grant and expense recognition; (iv) Sale of Kanjurmarg property not recognized pending definitive agreement; (v) Income recognition under JDA for Alibaug land; (vi) One-time increase in gratuity/leave liability due to New Labour Code; (vii) Penalty of Rs. 17,000 lakhs by ADGFT not provided for; (viii) Balances subject to confirmation.

key_risks: Impairment reversal and disposal uncertainty of Alibaug factory PPE
Non-provision for impairment of capital advance to Saumya Buildcon Pvt Ltd
Pending execution of definitive agreement for Kanjurmarg property sale
Variable consideration and lack of development under JDA for Alibaug land
Contingent liability of Rs. 17,000 lakhs penalty by ADGFT not provided for
Balances with banks, current assets and liabilities subject to confirmation
One-time increase in employee benefit liabilities due to New Labour Code
